- [ ] Accessibility: contrast via tokens, 44 pt hit areas, Dynamic Type at AX5, VoiceOver labels, Reduce Motion, RTL
- [ ] Previews and Showcase catalog updated
- [ ] No Swift 6 concurrency warnings
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
